name: storm
description: STORM research (Stanford OVAL): multi-perspective question asking with subagents, run in parallel or sequentially, producing a cited Wikipedia-style article.

mode.title: Default mode
mode.description: How STORM's subagents run by default: all at once (parallel) or one after another (sequential, each sees the earlier ones' work).

perspectives.title: Perspectives
perspectives.description: How many expert perspectives to research the topic from (STORM's simulated conversations).

turns.title: Questions per conversation
turns.description: How many question/answer rounds each perspective's conversation runs.

maxParallel.title: Max parallel subagents
maxParallel.description: The most subagents running at once in parallel mode.

outputDir.title: Output folder
outputDir.description: Where runs are written, relative to the session's working directory.

model.title: Subagent model
model.description: Model alias or id for STORM's subagents, or inherit.
